title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier with Integrated Towel Bar, Solid Brass Hardware Allied Brass
body_html:
Add organized storage to your bath with a wall mount glass shelf featuring three tiers and an integrated towel bar, crafted with solid brass hardware and 3/8-inch tempered glass.

  • Triple-tier storage: three glass shelves help organize toiletries and display essentials
  • Integrated towel bar: keeps hand towels within easy reach
  • Tempered, beveled-edge glass: 3/8-inch thick for safety and strength
  • Clean installation: concealed screw mounting hardware for a refined look
  • Finish flexibility: available in 28 designer finishes, including statement options like antique pewter, autumn sparkle, unlacquered brass, golden yellow, and glokzin teal

Specs

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
  • Overall dimensions: 16-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 18-Inch H
  • Material: Brass hardware
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8 in)
  • Weight capacity: 6 lb
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Designed to complement traditional bathroom hardware and coordinate with classic bath accessories for a cohesive, heritage-inspired look.

_previous.description: Add space and organization to your bathroom with this simple, contemporary style glass shelf. Featuring tempered, beveled-edged glass and solid brass hardware this shelf is crafted for durability, strength and style. Integrated towel bar provides space for your favorite decorative towels or for your everyday use. One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass Collection of products, this subtle glass shelf is the perfect complement to your bathroom decor.
